results.question: Find fMRI datasets with Alzheimer's patients
results.explanation: Find fMRI datasets containing participants diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.
results.sql:
SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'functional_mri' OR o2.suffix = 'fmri_bold'))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('alzheimers_disease')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer:AB | alzheimers:AB | (alzhiemer:AB & disease:AB) | (alzeimer:AB & disease:AB)')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease))')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'the search term appears only further down in the README' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('alzheimers_disease')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer:AB | alzheimers:AB | (alzhiemer:AB & disease:AB) | (alzeimer:AB & disease:AB)')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease))'))) THEN 1 WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS uk WHERE uk.dataset_id = d.id AND uk.diagnosis IS NOT NULL)) THEN 9 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) AS p0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

results.explanation: Find datasets that contain both structural MRI and functional MRI data.

results.question: Find datasets with structural MRI in sickle cell disease
results.explanation: Find datasets that contain structural MRI data and include participants with sickle cell disease.
results.sql:
SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'anatomical_mri' OR o2.suffix IN ('t1_weighted_mri', 't2_weighted_mri')))) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'sickle & cell & disease')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'sickle & cell & disease') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'sickle & cell & disease'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'sickle & cell')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: disease' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'functional_mri' OR o2.suffix = 'fmri_bold'))) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'anatomical_mri' OR o2.suffix IN ('t1_weighted_mri', 't2_weighted_mri')))) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.suffix = 'multi_echo_gre')) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & lifespan')))) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: adult' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: test' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1 OR us.u1 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & lifespan'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u1,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(cross <-> sectional) & adult & lifespan'))) AS p0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'scores & cognitive & test'))) AS p1
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence
